user.title: Connect your Cync account
user.description: Used once, here, to retrieve your Bluetooth mesh credentials from the Cync cloud API. After this, control is entirely local - see the README.

otp.title: Enter the verification code
otp.description: Cync emailed a one-time verification code to your account email address.

select_home.title: Choose a home
select_home.description: Your Cync account has more than one home. Each has its own Bluetooth mesh, so pick the one this integration should control - add it again for another.

confirm.title: Confirm setup
confirm.description: Found {device_count} controllable device(s) in "{home_name}". Continue to finish setup.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Cync cloud API. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.no_devices: No controllable devices were found on this Cync account.

init.title: Bluetooth adapter
init.description:
Cync devices refuse the descriptor write Home Assistant's Bluetooth stack performs when subscribing, and the connection is dropped as a result. Dedicating a **spare** adapter lets this integration drive it directly and avoid that entirely.

An adapter used this way is taken away from Home Assistant completely for as long as it is in use. Adapters already in use are still offered, but choosing one asks for confirmation first. {free} of {total} adapter(s) are currently free.

Leave this on the default unless you have a spare Bluetooth dongle.

confirm_takeover.title: Take {adapter} away from Home Assistant?
confirm_takeover.description:
**{label}** is the adapter Home Assistant is currently using for Bluetooth.

If you continue, this integration takes it over exclusively. For as long as it does:

- Home Assistant's Bluetooth scanner stops working on this adapter
- Every other Bluetooth integration relying on it — locks, sensors, beacons, thermostats — stops working
- Bluetooth discovery of new devices stops

This is reversible: set the adapter back to the default here and restart to hand it back.

Only continue if this machine has another way to reach your other Bluetooth devices, such as an ESPHome Bluetooth proxy, or if you do not use any.

error.adapter_missing: That adapter is no longer present. It may have been unplugged — reopen this page to see the current list.
error.not_confirmed: Tick the box to confirm you want to take this adapter away from Home Assistant, or go back and choose a different one.
